question: What kind of practitioner becomes a mockery of the Kula scripture?
premises: A seeker motivated by greed is described
Such a person is called a mockery of Kula scripture
inference: A greedy and fickle seeker is a mockery of the Kula scripture
uncertainties: Whether capalā agrees with an implied feminine subject or is used generally
plain_english: One who seeks out of greed and is always fickle is a mockery of the Kula scripture.
